decisions.evidence: The unchanged pre/post snapshots bind raw item 145eb801c74b3ca3e5ce71be0e055c8fd7b0a0f411f21d6d9a4113a4f2bc0940; no reader repair occurred. Independently checked Beisert Section 13.2, printed pp. 13.3–13.6 (one-based PDF pp. 155–158), equations (13.10)–(13.28): ideal conducting hollow-guide walls, vacuum Maxwell reduction and neglected penetration. This does not justify the original locator phrase “for the stated waveguide class” when arbitrary transverse coefficients/wall conditions are allowed. The current Definition independently assumes finite channels, both flux pairings and a unique solution map; its conditional validity is unaffected. Qualified only the source locator to that narrower setting and the independent finite-list assumption; Definition and physical_scope unchanged. Both routed findings concern this single nonfatal citation defect; current risk review and direct suppliers checked.
